Test Steps: Verify Admin can add a new Asset to Inventory
Test Data: 1. Log in as Admin 2. Go to Assets > Inventory 3. Click 'Add Asset' 4. Fill Category (Laptop), Brand, Serial Number, Purchase Date, Value 5. Save
Date of execution: Asset is added to inventory successfully and its status is 'Available'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when mandatory fields are left blank
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Asset' 2. Leave 'Category' and 'Serial Number' blank 3. Save
Date of execution: System displays validation error indicating missing mandatory fields.

Test Steps: Verify validation for duplicate Serial Number
Test Data: 1. Click 'Add Asset' 2. Enter a Serial Number that already exists in DB 3. Save
Date of execution: System rejects submission and shows 'Serial Number already exists' error.

Test Steps: Verify validation for Warranty/Expiry Dates
Test Data: 1. Enter Purchase Date as Today 2. Enter Warranty Expiry Date as Yesterday 3. Save
Date of execution: System blocks submission with 'Expiry date cannot be before Purchase date' error.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can assign an 'Available' asset to an Employee
Test Data: 1. Go to Assign Asset 2. Select an 'Available' Laptop 3. Select an Active Employee 4. Assign
Date of execution: Asset is assigned successfully and its status changes to 'Assigned'.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Admin attempts to assign an already 'Assigned' asset
Test Data: 1. Go to Assign Asset 2. Search for an asset currently assigned to someone else
Date of execution: System does not list 'Assigned' assets in the selection dropdown.

Test Steps: Verify validation when Admin attempts to assign an asset to an 'Inactive' employee
Test Data: 1. Select an Available Asset 2. Search for a terminated employee
Date of execution: System does not list inactive employees in the assignment dropdown.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can mark an assigned asset as 'Returned'
Test Data: 1. Select an Assigned Asset 2. Click 'Revoke / Return' 3. Enter return date 4. Confirm
Date of execution: Asset status changes from 'Assigned' back to 'Available' for reallocation.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can update Asset condition to 'Damaged' or 'Lost'
Test Data: 1. Select an Asset 2. Change condition from 'Good' to 'Lost'
Date of execution: Asset status updates and it becomes unavailable for future assignments.

Test Steps: Verify Asset recovery validation during Full & Final Settlement (FnF)
Test Data: 1. Initiate FnF for an employee who has pending assets
Date of execution: System flags a warning/error that 'Assets must be recovered before final settlement'.

Test Steps: Verify integration for deducting 'Lost' asset value during FnF
Test Data: 1. Asset is marked 'Lost' by employee 2. Process FnF
Date of execution: System automatically adds the asset's depreciated value as a deduction in FnF (if integrated).

Test Steps: Verify Employee can view Assets assigned to them
Test Data: 1. Log in as Employee 2. Go to My Assets
Date of execution: Employee dashboard lists all hardware/software currently held by them.

Test Steps: Verify Employee Acknowledgment feature
Test Data: 1. Admin assigns asset 2. Employee logs in 3. Clicks 'Acknowledge Receipt'
Date of execution: System records the timestamp and IP of the employee's digital acknowledgment.

Test Steps: Verify Employee can raise a Support/Repair Ticket for their assigned asset
Test Data: 1. Go to My Assets 2. Click 'Report Issue' on Laptop 3. Describe issue 4. Submit
Date of execution: A ticket is created and linked specifically to that Asset's Serial Number.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can filter assets by Status
Test Data: 1. Go to Asset Inventory 2. Select Filter > Status = 'Damaged'
Date of execution: Table updates to show only damaged inventory.

Test Steps: Verify Admin can filter assets by Category
Test Data: 1. Select Filter > Category = 'Mobile Phone'
Date of execution: Table displays only mobile phone assets.

Test Steps: Verify Export functionality for Asset Inventory
Test Data: 1. Click 'Export to CSV' on Inventory page
Date of execution: CSV file downloads successfully containing current asset states and assignments.

Test Steps: Verify Non-Admin employees cannot assign or edit assets
Test Data: 1. Log in as regular Employee 2. Try to access /hrms/assets/manage directly
Date of execution: System redirects to dashboard with '403 Access Denied' message.

Test Steps: Verify SQL Injection in Asset Search input
Test Data: 1. Go to Asset Inventory 2. Enter SQL payload in search bar
Date of execution: System handles query safely without leaking entire inventory data.

Test Data: 1. Add Asset 2. Enter <script>alert('XSS')</script> in Asset Name
